conviction_note: A Q1 print with no forecast revision or new return expected. The bar is low: Q1 is the seasonal trough (OP 16.8-18.0% of the full year in each of the last two years), the plan is +11.4% after a year where the company beat its plan by 16%, and the yen was roughly 8-9% weaker against the dollar YoY on two-thirds overseas sales. Against that sit weak Japanese OEM volumes in Aug, the company's own warning about a resin-cost pass-through lag, a crowded margin long (信用倍率 26.9), and last year's identical Q1 setup, which sold off 7.5%. The findings sum to +0.8 and the scaled number to +0.48 (p_up 55 x abs 4.8). They agree in sign, and both are small because the lean rests on inference, not on a disclosed number.
bar: No quarterly or H1 guide and no live consensus (kabuyoho/IFIS shows '--' for FY2027; the IFIS FY27 number on monex was 20% below the company's plan and is stale). The bar used is the company FY2027 plan (sales 105,000m, OP 7,900m, ordinary 7,100m, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260522544266.pdf) read through this name's own Q1 progress history (Q1 OP 1,019m FY25 and 1,190m FY26; ordinary progress 5-yr average 12.6%, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7888&b=k202510090007). Imamura's estimate equals the company plan. That is a single-source bar, so the sizes are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the sealed baseline). 信用倍率 26.86 per the baseline and kabutan on 2026-10-09 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7888), so the margin long is crowded. No options and no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.78, almost all from margin overhang. 20d run-up +1.35%, 5d -0.77%. The stock drifted from about 950 at end-July to 900, still about 17% below the February high of 1,088.

findings.finding: The Q1 bar is low relative to a conservatively set plan. Q1 (Jun-Aug) is the seasonal trough: Q1 OP was 1,019m and 1,190m, or 18.0% and 16.8% of full-year actual. FY26 OP of 7,091m beat the original 6,100m plan by 16%, and Q4 FY26 OP grew 47.5% YoY to 2,340m (9.3% margin). A flat Q1 OP of 1,190m would already be 15% of the 7,900m plan, above the 5-year average ordinary progress of 12.6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 prints: Oct 2024 about +6.6% (estimated window); Oct 2025 -7.5% on a +16.8% OP Q1 with the plan held ('出尽くし', after a run to record highs, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7888&b=n202510100499). Full-year beats were bought hard: stop-high on 2025-07-11 and on 2026-07-15.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no consensus for the quarter or the year (kabuyoho shows '--'), and only one regional broker covers the name. At PER 6.1 and PBR 0.79, after drifting from 950 to 900 since July, the price does not look like it expects a continued double-digit-growth quarter. If it did, the stock would have held its post-July level the way it ran into the Oct 2025 print.
findings.independence: Imamura Securities (2026-07-30) expects record OP to continue on high-value orders and productivity: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7888&b=n202607300831. The same company documents underlie both.

findings.finding: Q1 volume and margin headwinds. Japanese OEM global sales fell in Aug 2026 (Toyota -6.4%, Honda -9.2%, Nissan -17.5%, mainly China), Toyota's production fell for a second month in Aug, and in July the company itself said resin-cost increases from the Middle East situation are passed through only with a lag, which could hurt short-term results.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print where this company named a raw-material lag. Q4 FY26 (Mar-May 2026, after the late-Feb Middle East shock) still grew OP 47.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The OEM data is public and the company comment was published in July. It is filed because nobody has quantified it for this company. No customer is above 10% of sales (FY26 tanshin), so the read-through is diluted, and the China weakness hits a small part of Sanko's Asia segment.
findings.independence: The company comment on the raw-material lag, in Imamura's 2026-07-01 Hokuriku note: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=7888&b=n202607010627

findings.finding: Translation tailwind: USD/JPY averaged roughly 157-162 in Jun-Aug 2026 against about 145-149 a year earlier, and THB/JPY about 4.7-4.9 against 4.4-4.6. About two-thirds of sales (Asia 31.7bn, North America 22.3bn, Europe 12.4bn of 98.0bn) are overseas.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not separable. Q4 FY26 already carried a similar FX gap and printed sales +5.6% YoY.
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission and mostly inside the plan, which was set in July with the yen near 160. Kept small. It matters only for the YoY optics of a quarter with no guide.
findings.independence: Regional sales split from the FY26 tanshin: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260522544266.pdf

findings.finding: The Siam Aisin brake-part recall arbitration was settled on 2026-08-24. The company states the settlement's impact was fully reflected in FY26 (a special loss of THB 734m, about 3,599m yen, booked in Q4). The claim had sought about 4.7bn. So Q1 should carry no new special loss on this item, and FY27 net profit of 4,500m loses its main overhang.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The July 2026 print carrying the 3.6bn loss went limit-up on the OP beat, so holders looked through the one-off.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, because it was disclosed on 2026-08-25. What is left is the chance that a confidential settlement below the accrual shows up as a reversal gain in Q1, which is unknowable. It is a one-off below OP, so it is sized at a fraction.

outside_window.finding: Imamura (2026-07-30) reports the company plans an M&A around Alabama within calendar 2026 to add a US South base, plus an India new plant and expansion in 2027 and Czech capacity for 2028. The timing is undated, so it may or may not be announced with Q1.

Returns: not expected; the interim 16 yen was already set and there is no buyback history. New-year guide: n/a at Q1. Quarter vs its own 進捗率: Q1 OP was 18.0% (FY25) and 16.8% (FY26) of the full year; flat YoY would be 15.1% of the 7,900m plan, and 5-yr average ordinary progress at Q1 is 12.6%.

rejected_candidates.detail: Merged into the OEM/resin-lag finding as its corroboration.

baseline_tension: The mild positive cuts against priced_lean_pct -0.78, which comes from the crowded margin long (信用倍率 26.9). That margin long is the main reason p_up stays at 55 and not higher, and last year's Q1 sold off 7.5% on a similar beat. The strongest positive the release could carry is the Alabama M&A or an early hint of upside to the plan. I looked for a revision, a buyback or an M&A notice ahead of the print and found none. The run-up is flat, so it says nothing.
lessons_applied: nothing changed. Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series: p_up toward 50) applies to the OEM/resin finding, which was already small and partly priced, and p_up was already near 50 at 55. Rule 2 (negative tilt) does not apply because the set leans positive, and the strongest positive was looked for and recorded in baseline_tension.
